name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Generation)
description: Compact true-wireless earbuds with active noise cancellation, a pocket-friendly charging case, and a snug, secure fit for calls, workouts, and everyday listening.
details: Bluetooth device. Touch controls let you manage playback and calls without reaching for your phone, and the case delivers multiple extra charges on the go.

name: One-Handed RGB Gaming Keypad
description: A compact one-handed mechanical-style keypad with per-key RGB backlighting and a padded wrist rest, built for fast-paced gaming sessions.
details: Designed for quick reflexes, this keypad packs macro-ready keys, a soft-touch wrist rest, and vivid customizable RGB lighting into a compact footprint that leaves room for your mouse hand to roam free.

name: Premium Over-Ear Gaming Headset
description: Plush over-ear cushions, a flip-up boom mic, and a clean white finish make this headset as comfortable as it is stylish.
details: Soft memory-foam ear cushions and an adjustable headband keep long sessions comfortable, while the flip-to-mute boom mic keeps communication clear. A braided cable and inline controls round out the everyday-durable build.

name: Laptop Stand Aluminum Alloy
description: A sleek aluminum laptop stand that folds flat for travel and adjusts to multiple heights for better posture at your desk.
details: Machined from lightweight aluminum, this stand raises your laptop to eye level to ease neck and back strain, improves airflow underneath the chassis, and collapses flat in seconds for travel or storage.

name: Wired Precision Gaming Mouse
description: An ergonomic wired gaming mouse with adjustable DPI, a textured grip, and subtle backlit accents.
details: Built for accuracy, this mouse offers adjustable DPI settings for quick sensitivity changes, a braided cable for durability, and an ergonomic shape designed for extended gaming sessions.

name: Mushroom Water-Powered LED Lamp
description: A charmingly simple mushroom-shaped night lamp that runs on water power, casting a soft warm glow for bedside or desk.
details: Just add tap water to the base and this eco-friendly lamp lights up with a gentle, warm-white glow. Its soft silicone cap and compact size make it a sweet addition to any nightstand or reading corner.

name: House-Shaped Wooden Savings Bank
description: A charming house-shaped wooden money box with a built-in savings challenge chart to help you build a savings habit.
details: Turn saving into a game with this printed challenge grid built right onto the wooden house facade. Simply tick off each amount as you deposit it and watch your savings add up to the printed goal.

name: All-in-One Keychain Power Bank
description: A pocket-sized power bank with built-in charging tips, so you can top up your phone without hunting for a cable.
details: This keychain-friendly power bank folds out built-in Lightning, USB-C, and Micro-USB tips, meaning there's no separate cable to lose. Clip it to your bag or keys for backup power wherever you go.

name: 3D Acrylic Calendar Memo Lamp
description: A soft-glow acrylic LED panel etched with a monthly calendar and memo space, perfect for a desk that stays organized and pretty.
details: The engraved acrylic plate catches the LED base's light along every etched line, illuminating a monthly calendar grid and a small memo box you can reference at a glance. A gentle, functional piece of desk decor.

name: Handheld Scalp & Body Massager
description: A compact handheld massager with flexible fingertip claws that glide over the scalp for a relaxing, spa-like massage.
details: The soft, flexible tines mimic real fingertips to gently knead the scalp, helping you unwind after a long day. Lightweight and easy to grip, it's built for quick relaxation breaks anywhere.

name: Feather Globe LED Night Light
description: A dreamy glass globe filled with soft feathers and warm fairy lights, sitting on a ribbed pastel base.
details: Warm LED strands glow gently through a feather-filled glass globe for a cozy, ambient light that suits a nightstand, shelf, or nursery. The ribbed base gives it a soft, sculptural look even when switched off.

name: Portable Handheld Mini Fan
description: A foldable, rechargeable mini fan with a rotating head, small enough to slip into a bag for on-the-go cooling.
details: This fan folds flat for easy carrying and unfolds into a rotating handheld cooling companion. Rechargeable via USB, it's a practical everyday-carry piece for commutes, workouts, or hot afternoons.

name: Retro Cash Cannon Toy
description: A novelty cash-dispensing party toy that flutters bills into the air for birthdays, celebrations, and fun photo moments.
details: A crowd-pleaser at parties and celebrations, this novelty toy sends bills fluttering through the air at the press of a trigger. A fun, playful gift for the person who loves a memorable entrance.

name: Pink Bubble Gun with Bubble Solution
description: A playful pink bubble-blowing toy that comes with its own bottle of bubble solution, ready for outdoor fun.
details: Squeeze the trigger and watch a stream of bubbles float into the air. Comes with a bottle of colorful bubble solution, making it a delightful pick-up-and-play gift for kids.

name: SMY-63A Wireless Headphones
description: SMY-63A Wireless Headphones deliver clear sound, comfortable listening, and reliable wireless connectivity for music, gaming, and everyday use.
details: Designed for everyday entertainment, the SMY-63A features a comfortable over-ear design, wireless Bluetooth connectivity, immersive audio, and a rechargeable battery for convenient long-lasting use.
